14.3.5 Displays of Vital Signs, Weight and Concomitant Medications

NOT AN E3 SUBSECTION. E3 enumerates four subsections under 14.3 - adverse event displays, death and serious adverse event listings, narratives, and the abnormal laboratory value listing - and provides no slot for the vital signs, weight and concomitant medication data its own Sections 12.5 and 12.6 require the report to present. This subsection is an addition made by this document model, in the place E3 leaves for the rest of the safety data, and it is declared here rather than folded into 14.3.4 so that nothing about it looks like it came from the guideline. The reference report for this study made the same move under its own numbering, as Table 14-7.01 to Table 14-7.04.
